name: factor-mining-demo
description: MCP-first demo plugin for the direct vt_ Agent API Key Factor Mining workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Demo direct vt_ Agent API Key backtesting through bundled MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Factor Mining Demo lets Codex write local plugin.py factors, validate metadata, upload to Factor Mining, run user-scoped backtests, retrieve factor cards, and summarize results through bundled MCP tools. The demo stores a direct vt_ Agent API Key locally after secure local browser entry.
defaultPrompt: Show me the Factor Mining Demo public task list.
Use Factor Mining Demo with my custom factor idea.
Switch Factor Mining Demo to a different vt_ key.
Resume my Factor Mining Demo run and summarize results.
